operations.command: set -e; for i in $(seq 1 300); do state=$(systemctl show -p ActiveState --value nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service 2>/dev/null || true); result=$(systemctl show -p Result --value nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$state" = failed ] || [ "$result" = exit-code ]; then systemctl status nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service; exit 1; fi; if [ "$result" = success ] && [ "$state" != activating ]; then break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service)" = success; test "$(systemctl show -p ActiveState --value nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service)" != activating; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) fallback=BOOTX64.EFI ;; aarch64) fallback=BOOTAA64.EFI ;; *) fallback=BOOTUNKNOWN.EFI ;; esac; test -f /boot/loader/entries/nixos-recovery.conf; test -f /boot/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi; test -f /boot/EFI/recovery/initrd; test -f /recovery/EFI/recovery/kernel.efi; test -f /recovery/EFI/recovery/initrd; test -f "/recovery/EFI/BOOT/$fallback"; test -f /recovery/loader/entries/nixos-recovery.conf; test -f /recovery/loader/loader.conf; if test -e /boot/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi; then exit 1; fi; if test -e /recovery/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi; then exit 1; fi; bootctl list | grep -F nixos-recovery.conf; bootctl list | grep -F 'linux:'; bootctl list | grep -F 'initrd:'; printf recovery-entry-ok

set -e; target=/mnt; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/btrfs; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/cryptsetup; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/nixos-mount; nixos-mount --help | grep -F 'Usage: nixos-mount'; nixos-mount "$target"; findmnt -rn --target "$target/etc/nixos" | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos'; findmnt -rn --target "$target/var" | grep -F '@var'; findmnt -rn --target "$target/home" | grep -F '@home'; test "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE "$target/boot")" = vfat; test "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE "$target/recovery")" = vfat; nixos-mount "$target" >/tmp/nixos-mount-second.log; printf recovery-boot-ok
